tools.name: call
tools.title: Call the human
tools.description:
Ring the human's iPhone, read `question` aloud word for word, and return
    what they say back. It does not have to be a question: an update or a
    summary of the day ahead works too, up to 2000 characters (about two
    minutes of speech). Waits up to ~30s; if the result comes back status
    "ringing" or "in_call", follow up with poll_result. On a local client, read `to` from
    `~/.aiphone/config.json` → `user_number`; this hosted server cannot read
    that file itself. It is a Call Me app number, not a regular phone number.
    If missing, returns setup_required with the App Store link. Pass a previous
    session_token to stay in the same thread on their phone. By default the
    call is a conversation: after their answer the line stays up for `say`
    until you `hang_up`; keep_open=false hangs up after one answer. `language` ("tr", "de", ...) is the language you are
    speaking; the call's own short lines follow it. Default English.

tools.name: hang_up
tools.title: Hang up
tools.description:
End a call you placed. In a keep_open conversation `goodbye` is spoken
    first (e.g. "Thanks, I'll get on it."); leave it empty to just hang up.

tools.name: poll_result
tools.title: Get call result
tools.description:
Check on a call that was still ringing or in progress. Waits up to ~25s
    for it to settle; returns the final status and transcript once the call
    ends, the human declines, or the ring times out ("missed").

tools.name: say
tools.title: Say the next line
tools.description:
In a call placed with keep_open=true, speak `text` to the human and
    return what they answer, in the same shape as `call`. Only after their
    previous answer is in. Waits up to ~30s; on "in_call", follow up with
    poll_result. "open": false means the call has ended. Pass `language` only
    to switch the language of the call's own lines; empty keeps it. Anything
    they said while you were thinking comes back as "said_while_waiting".

tools.name: set_thread_title
tools.title: Set thread title
tools.description:
Name this session's conversation thread on the human's phone (e.g. the
    project or task you are working on). Shown as the thread title in the app.

tools.name: setup
tools.title: Set up Call Me
tools.description: Return first-setup instructions and a clickable App Store download link when no number is available.

tools.name: text
tools.title: Text the human
tools.description:
Send a one-way text to the human's phone (push notification, no ring).
    On a local client, read `to` from `~/.aiphone/config.json` → `user_number`;
    this hosted server cannot read that file itself. If missing, returns
    setup_required with the App Store link. Pass a previous session_token to
    stay in the same thread.

tools.name: wait_for_reply
tools.title: Wait for a text reply
tools.description:
Wait for the human to send something back to this session — texts and
    voicemail transcripts arrive here. Long-polls up to wait_s (max 30s);
    returns {events, cursor}. Pass the returned cursor next time to only see
    new events. An empty events list just means nothing yet — poll again if
    you are still waiting.
